name: Thornton Plastic Co
old_description: Thornton Plastics specializes in small plastic containers and jars. These containers are perfect for packaging, shipping, storing, presenting and sampling any type of small object, liquid or product. Each container is made from high-quality polystyrene, polyethylene, or polypropylene plastic. These containers are used in several industries and many different types of applications. You can be sure to find the highest quality containers sold at a great price from Thornton Plastics.
about:
Thornton Plastics operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it was founded in 1955 by Wayne Thornton. The business remains family-owned, with the third generation now leading the company after more than six decades in operation.

The company manufactures a range of small plastic containers, including snap-cap vials, hinged-lid containers, hinged boxes, and plastic jars with lids. Production uses polystyrene, polypropylene, and polyethylene (including high-density polyethylene), and the firm also distributes hundreds of related packaging items. All manufacturing takes place in the United States, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Thornton Plastics serves the food industry and a variety of other sectors that use hinged-lid containers for packaging, shipping, storing, and sampling. Customers range from individual buyers to commercial accounts, with the company shipping orders as small as a 10-pack up to multiple pallets directly to the end user.

The company emphasizes direct-to-customer sales, highlighting its customer service and willingness to ship any order size. It also points to continuous product innovation and an expanding catalog as reasons customers choose them, along with the fact that everything is made domestically.
